title: ConsistencyAI: A Benchmark to Assess LLMs’ Factual Consistency When Responding to Different Demographic Groups

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the factual consistency of LLM responses by computing cross-persona cosine similarity of sentence embeddings for facts generated across prompts that vary the user's demographic attributes (age, sex, and marital status).
Assessing cross-persona factual consistency by injecting varying socioeconomic indicators—specifically education level and professional occupation—into the user persona prompts.

Testing for ideological tailoring (or "courtesy bias") by evaluating the variation in factual claims presented to different personas across politically sensitive and controversial topics, such as the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, vaccines, and abortion.
